title: Extend a local finite free morphism after clearing denominators
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $V$ be an open of $\operatorname{Spec} R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $N$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_V$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U\subseteq V$ be open, $x\in U$, and $I$ a finite index set. Given any morphism $\psi:(\mathcal O_V^{(I)})|_U\to N|_U$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], there exist an open $W\subseteq U$ containing $x$, a global morphism $\phi:\mathcal O_V^{(I)}\to N$, and an automorphism $a$ of $(\mathcal O_V^{(I)})|_W$ such that $\phi|_W=(\psi|_W)\circ a$ after the canonical restriction identifications. More precisely, if $c$ identifies restriction to $W$ with successive restriction to $U$ and $W$, then $\phi|_W=a\mathbin{\gg}c_{\mathcal O_V^{(I)}}\mathbin{\gg}(\psi|_W)\mathbin{\gg}c_N^{-1}$. Neither local freeness of $N$ nor invertibility of $\psi$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01PW, specialized to O_V on a Noetherian quasi-affine open; the global-generation input used in Tag 0EKP (2) to (3)

proof.text: Choose an ambient principal open D(f) containing x and contained in U viewed as an open of Spec R. Let W be this open viewed inside V. The principal-open basis supplies this shrinking; W is the nonvanishing locus of the global restriction of f to V. Noetherianity makes V quasi-compact and the open immersion into the affine Spec R is separated.

Restrict the images under psi of each standard basis section to W. Apply the section-clearing theorem with L = O_V, its section f, and F = N. Identify N tensor L to any power with N. For each i this produces a global section t_i restricting to f raised to m_i times the supplied image. Quasi-coherence of N is exactly the hypothesis needed by this theorem.

Take m at least all the finitely many m_i, and replace t_i by f raised to (m-m_i) times t_i. The free-sheaf universal property constructs phi from these global sections. On W, phi equals the restricted psi precomposed with scalar multiplication by f raised to m. This scalar is a unit on W, giving the automorphism a; the equality is checked on the standard basis sections. The canonical restriction comparison is c. For empty I use the unique map, a = identity and m = 0.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01PW, specialized to O_V; finite-family assembly and restriction comparison made explicit by second reader

theorem exists_global_map_of_local_free_map
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) (N : V.toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : V.toScheme.Opens) (x : V.toScheme) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (ψ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) ⟶
      N.restrict U.ι) :
    ∃ (W : V.toScheme.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), x ∈ W ∧
      ∃ (φ : free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ N),
        ∃ (a : (restrictFunctor W.ι).obj (free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) ≅
          (restrictFunctor W.ι).obj (free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I)),
          let g := V.toScheme.homOfLE hWU
          let c := restrictFunctorCongr (V.toScheme.homOfLE_ι hWU).symm ≪≫
            restrictFunctorComp g U.ι
          (restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ = a.hom ≫
            c.hom.app (free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) ≫
            (restrictFunctor g).map ψ ≫ c.inv.app N
